text: LedgerLite: The Starter plan cost per month is 12 dollars.
LedgerLite: The discount for paying annually is 20 percent.
LedgerLite: The free trial is 30 days.
LedgerLite: The number of invoices on the Starter plan is 50 per month.
LedgerLite: The number of invoice currencies supported is 40 currencies.
LedgerLite: Automatic payment reminders is every 7 days.
LedgerLite: The number of employees payroll supports is up to 25 employees.
LedgerLite: Payroll runs per month is unlimited runs.
LedgerLite: The number of tax regions supported is 12 regions.
LedgerLite: The quarterly filing deadline reminder is 10 days before the deadline.
LedgerLite: The number of banks that sync is over 9,000 banks.
LedgerLite: How often bank transactions refresh is every 4 hours.
LedgerLite: The two-factor methods offered is authenticator apps and security keys.
LedgerLite: The idle session timeout is 30 minutes.
LedgerLite: How long deleted data is kept is 30 days.
How to get started with billing in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose billing.
How to get started with invoices in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose invoices.
How to get started with payroll in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose payroll.
How to get started with tax in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose tax.
How to get started with bank sync in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose bank-sync.
How to get started with security in LedgerLite: open Settings and choose security.
